title: Long-term survival outcomes of neoadjuvant chemotherapy in stage II-III HR+/HER2- breast cancer
population: 21,299 stage II-III HR+/HER2- breast cancer patients from the SEER database (2010-2021)
notes: Neoadjuvant chemotherapy in stage II-III HR+/HER2- breast cancer is associated with inferior long-term survival outcomes compared to adjuvant chemotherapy.
